Joining a Donation-Based group must route to checkout — the $3 platform fee is charged on join exactly as it is on a Free group, proven with clean accounts on 2026-08-26.

If JPM-07's one-time payment was refused just before this, that is the thing to report: a refused payment appears to leave the member able to join for free afterwards. A declined card does not do that (it grants no access at all), so this is specific to however the one-time refusal fails.
